text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki went to watch the Arima 
Kinen. Once again, Oguri Cap's popularity 
was immense,
but rumors said her condition 
had recently taken a downturn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even as they enter the course, Oguri Cap 
keeps her head hung low the entire time. 
Yaeno Muteki gives her a stern rebuke.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap's running draws power from the 
cheers of the crowd. Therefore,
she should 
hold her head high and feel their
support. 
At those words, Oguri Cap found her fire 
once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race,
Yaeno Muteki praises Oguri 
Cap for regaining her true way of running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap expressed her gratitude and
told 
Yaeno Muteki that she wanted to run with 
her next time.
